Customer A takes six minutes; B, C and D take two minutes each. All four are already there at minute 0, lined up in the order A, B, C, D, and each line serves its own people first come, first served. In the upper chart, labelled one line, counter 1 runs A from minute 0 to 6 while counter 2 runs B, then C, then D, back to back, finishing at minute 6. Both counters then stand empty, marked idle, from minute 6 to 8, with nobody left to serve. Nothing is left waiting while a counter stands empty, and the longest anyone waits is four minutes. In the lower chart, labelled a line per counter, A and C joined counter 1 and B and D joined counter 2. Counter 1 runs A from 0 to 6 and then C from 6 to 8, while counter 2 serves B and then D, so D is served before C, and finishes D at minute 4 and then sits empty, marked idle, from minute 4 to 6 while C is still waiting and again from minute 6 to 8, and the longest wait is six minutes instead of four.

2feba65ffd1f.text: Two weighted averages drawn on one left-to-right scale of success rate, with no numbers. The upper line belongs to the option that leads in both groups: its two group rates are marked as open circles, and both of them sit further right, that is higher, than the matching circles on the lower line. Its pooled figure is drawn as a square and sits close to its left-hand circle, because most of its trials ran in the harder group. The lower line belongs to the option that trails in both groups: its pooled figure is drawn as a diamond and sits close to its right-hand circle, because most of its trials ran in the easier group. Dashed lines drop from both pooled marks to the scale, and the diamond lands further right than the square. So the option that trails on both lines wins the pooled total, and the mark sits wherever the trials sat.

a001c22a9200.text: A hand-built case: two time charts of the same four customers at the same two counters, drawn one above the other against a shared minute scale from zero to eight. Customer A takes six minutes; B, C and D take two minutes each. All four are already there at minute 0, lined up in the order A, B, C, D, and each line serves its own people first come, first served. In the upper chart, labelled one line, counter 1 runs A from minute 0 to 6 while counter 2 runs B, then C, then D, back to back, finishing at minute 6. Both counters then stand empty, marked idle, from minute 6 to 8, with nobody left to serve. Nothing is left waiting while a counter stands empty, and the longest anyone waits is four minutes. In the lower chart, labelled a line per counter, A and C joined counter 1 and B and D joined counter 2. Counter 1 runs A from 0 to 6 and then C from 6 to 8, while counter 2 serves B and then D, so D is served before C, and finishes D at minute 4 and then sits empty, marked idle, from minute 4 to 6 while C is still waiting and again from minute 6 to 8, and the longest wait is six minutes instead of four.

Two thin pale rings run round it, squashed flat to fit the band: a small one labelled Earth's ring, the name set just off its left end, and a wide one labelled the other body's ring, joined to it by a short leader line. Earth is a dot on the small ring, out to the right of the Sun, and it stays there. 6531dc4c8396.note: 30상태(창구 1, CV < 1). 각 절은 참: 두 평균 정확(CODE: src/widgets/one-line-or-many/model.js:143 c = 1 → C = ρ, P–K), 95%는 맞춘 꼬리(model.js:172-176), CV 1.00만 전부 정확(model.js:216). 결함: 창구 1(CV ≠ 1) 상태의 표 아래 문구는 '두 평균이 창구 하나에서 정확'하고 '95% 수치가 맞춘 꼬리'라고만 말한 뒤 'Only CV 1.00 leaves every figure exact'로 맺는다. 그런데 이 문구가 붙은 표('Both layouts at every counter count')는 창구 수 슬라이더와 상관없이 1~8행을 모두 보여 주고, 2~8행의 'One line, mean'과 'Mean cut by'는 두 모멘트 근사다(model.js:187, CALC 13.3·2.8). 문구가 근사인 것으로 95% 수치만 꼽으므로, 독자는 바로 위 표의 2~8행 한 줄 평균·배수를 정확값으로 읽게 된다(E17 빠뜨림). 같은 표·같은 CV에서 창구 수 슬라이더만 1↔2로 옮기면 표 내용은 그대로인데 근사라고 밝히는 대상이 바뀐다(E19 상태 의존). 본문(index.astro:339-340 'an approximation above it')은 창구 둘 이상의 한 줄 평균을 근사라고 하므로 이 상태의 위젯과 본문이 표의 같은 칸에 대해 다른 인상을 준다(E9). 글자 그대로의 각 절은 참(FALSE 아님). bd57bc5d8a24.note: 30상태(창구 1, CV > 1). 각 절은 참: 두 평균 정확(CODE: src/widgets/one-line-or-many/model.js:143 c = 1 → C = ρ, P–K), 95%는 맞춘 꼬리(model.js:172-176), CV 1.00만 전부 정확(model.js:216). 결함: 창구 1(CV ≠ 1) 상태의 표 아래 문구는 '두 평균이 창구 하나에서 정확'하고 '95% 수치가 맞춘 꼬리'라고만 말한 뒤 'Only CV 1.00 leaves every figure exact'로 맺는다. 그런데 이 문구가 붙은 표('Both layouts at every counter count')는 창구 수 슬라이더와 상관없이 1~8행을 모두 보여 주고, 2~8행의 'One line, mean'과 'Mean cut by'는 두 모멘트 근사다(model.js:187, CALC 13.3·2.8). 문구가 근사인 것으로 95% 수치만 꼽으므로, 독자는 바로 위 표의 2~8행 한 줄 평균·배수를 정확값으로 읽게 된다(E17 빠뜨림). 같은 표·같은 CV에서 창구 수 슬라이더만 1↔2로 옮기면 표 내용은 그대로인데 근사라고 밝히는 대상이 바뀐다(E19 상태 의존). 본문(index.astro:339-340 'an approximation above it')은 창구 둘 이상의 한 줄 평균을 근사라고 하므로 이 상태의 위젯과 본문이 표의 같은 칸에 대해 다른 인상을 준다(E9). 글자 그대로의 각 절은 참(FALSE 아님). VIS: work/r5a/r5a-olm-table-note-390_c_1_rho_0_8_es_3_cv_2.png — 문구 바로 위 표 2~8행 한 줄 평균(2.8·1.7·…·0.46 / 13.3·8.1·…·2.1)과 배수 2.3×~14.0×가 근사인데 문구는 95% 수치만 근사로 꼽는다. 고칠 문구: src/widgets/one-line-or-many/widget.js:347-350의 창구 수 분기를 없애고, 표 전체(1~8행)에 맞는 한 문장으로 CV ≠ 1 문구를 통일한다 — 예: `Service times vary ${spread} than the exponential case (CV ${…toFixed(2)}), so the one-line mean is exact at one counter and carries the two-moment approximation above it, a line per counter keeps an exact mean at every counter count, and the ${95%} figures keep an exponential tail shape fitted to them. Only CV 1.00 leaves every figure exact.` (본문 index.astro:339-341과 같은 구분). widget.test.js:190-197 단언문('the one-line mean carries the two-moment approximation', 'both means stay exact at one counter', not.toContain('two-moment approximation'))과 widget.js:330-341 주석을 같이 고치고 runtime-scan → B6 → ledger widget 재기록.
